Example: actual growth 2% and potential 3% gives a gap of −1%, so with an Okun coefficient of 2 the unemployment rate rises by about 0.5 percentage points.
map.经典约 −2（每 1% 产出缺口对应 −0.5% 失业反差），各国估计不同。结果: The classic value is about −2 (each 1% of output gap corresponds to −0.5% difference in unemployment), and estimates differ across countries.
